en-US.heroPrimary: ICS 46 is UCI's data structures course, focused on implementing classic data structures in C++ and analyzing their running time and memory use.
en-US.heroSecondary: This page collects lecture-by-lecture notes for classmates who want a structured review of templates, pointers and ownership, algorithm analysis, and data structures such as lists, stacks, and queues.
en-US.readerDescription: This page presents {course}{weekPhrase} notes in a structured reading format so you can review C++ templates, pointers and ownership, algorithm analysis, and data structure implementations lecture by lecture. The path below takes you back to Notes, Course Notes, the course page, or this note file. Hover over the ≡ icon on the right side to open the Table of Contents.

zh-CN.heroPrimary: ICS 46 是 UCI 的数据结构课程,重点在于用 C++ 实现经典数据结构,并分析它们的运行时间与内存开销。
zh-CN.heroSecondary: 这个页面汇总按讲整理的课程笔记,方便同学回顾模板、指针与所有权、算法分析,以及链表、栈、队列等数据结构。
zh-CN.readerHeading: 数据结构课程阅读笔记
zh-CN.readerDescription: 这页整理的是 {course}{weekPhrase} 的课程笔记，适合按讲复习 C++ 模板、指针与所有权、算法分析和各类数据结构的实现。下面这条路径可以带你回到 Notes、Course Notes、课程主页，或定位到当前笔记。将鼠标悬停在右侧的 ≡ 图标上可以打开目录。

summary.en-US: Unit tests, templates, references, pointers, smart pointers and arrays.
summary.zh-CN: 单元测试、模板、引用、指针、智能指针与数组。

summary.en-US: Empirical timing, Big-O / Ω / Θ, orders of growth, recurrences and the Master Theorem.
summary.zh-CN: 实测运行时间、Big-O / Ω / Θ、增长阶、递推式与主定理。

summary.en-US: ArrayList, linked lists, stacks, queues, deques and circular arrays.
summary.zh-CN: ArrayList、链表、栈、队列、双端队列与循环数组。

summary.en-US: Selection, insertion, merge, quick and heap sort.
summary.zh-CN: 选择、插入、归并、快速与堆排序。

summary.en-US: Tree terminology, binary trees, height bounds and traversals.
summary.zh-CN: 树的术语、二叉树、高度上下界与遍历。

summary.en-US: Binary heaps, swim and sink, heap construction and the priority queue ADT.
summary.zh-CN: 二叉堆、上浮与下沉、建堆与优先队列 ADT。

summary.en-US: Binary search trees, 2-3 trees and left-leaning red-black BSTs.
summary.zh-CN: 二叉搜索树、2-3 树与左倾红黑树。

summary.en-US: Hash functions, separate chaining, linear and quadratic probing.
summary.zh-CN: 哈希函数、拉链法、线性探测与二次探测。
